title: (RHBA-2022:0521) ACS 3.68.1 Bug Fix Update
portal_summary: Updated images are now available for Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes (RHACS). The updated image includes stability improvements.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|3|x86_64
portal_solution: If you are using the RHACS 3.68.0, you are advised to upgrade to patch release 3.68.1.
portal_description:
Bugfixes:

- Due to a bug in RHACS 3.68.0, sometimes, RHACS scoped incorrect registry credentials, and it would keep retrying to authenticate using those wrong credentials, which resulted in the internal database crash.
To solve this issue, RHACS now includes an updated automatic registry integrations logic to handle failure and reduce the load on registries more effectively.
-  In RHACS 3.68.0, Central would sometimes stop responding if the vulnerability data was not available. This issue has been fixed. Central now reports an error for such cases.

Changes:

- RHACS 3.68.1 includes a new `ROX_DISABLE_AUTOGENERATED_REGISTRIES` environment variable. You can set the `ROX_DISABLE_AUTOGENERATED_REGISTRIES` environment variable to `true` to ignore all new registry integrations from Sensors.

Bugfixes:

- Due to a bug in RHACS 3.68.0, sometimes, RHACS scoped incorrect registry credentials, and it would keep retrying to authenticate using those wrong credentials, which resulted in the internal database crash.
To solve this issue, RHACS now includes an updated automatic registry integrations logic to handle failure and reduce the load on registries more effectively.
-  In RHACS 3.68.0, Central would sometimes stop responding if the vulnerability data was not available. This issue has been fixed. Central now reports an error for such cases.

- RHACS 3.68.1 includes a new `ROX_DISABLE_AUTOGENERATED_REGISTRIES` environment variable. You can set the `ROX_DISABLE_AUTOGENERATED_REGISTRIES` environment variable to `true` to ignore all new registry integrations from Sensors.
